description: Header file defining the ModeSelector class for head-tracking mode selection in Android media, including method declarations, class members, and documentation.

classes.name: ModeSelector
classes.description: Class responsible for selecting and managing head-tracking modes and poses for audio virtualization.

methods.name: ModeSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing ModeSelector with options and initial mode.

methods.name: setScreenToStagePose
methods.description: Sets the pose from screen to stage.

methods.name: setScreenToHeadPose
methods.description: Sets the screen-to-head pose with timestamp and optional validity.

methods.name: setWorldToHeadPose
methods.description: Sets the world-to-head pose with timestamp.

methods.name: setScreenStable
methods.description: Indicates whether the screen is stable with timestamp.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Processes inputs and updates output poses and mode.

methods.name: getActualMode
methods.description: Returns the current actual head-tracking mode.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object at a given detail level.
